title: Let There Be Elsewhere
alignment: Authored times reference decoded original MP3. Canonical MP3 timing is verified against that recording; no additional entrance delay.

cues.text: I offer you a single perfect heaven.
One pitch. One will. One never ending day.
A sky without a door becomes a ceiling.
We need the right to hear another way.
Keep every voice that troubles your reflection.
Keep room for those who have not yet arrived.
Let there be elsewhere in the heart of heaven.
Let difference make the listening survive.
Then take the height; I will unclose its borders.
Then take the stars; we will not make them one.
Let organs lift the weight of many winters.
Let strings unfold the weather of the sun.
A stone, a page, a road, a room, a chorus.
A silence that the chorus will not eat.
A hand that opens when the singer answers.
A hundred worlds beneath our dancing feet.
Heaven is wide enough for other heavens.
Elsewhere, elsewhere, let the doors remain.
